title: Activities: Shanghai (verified rows only)
intro: Only fields confirmed on the venue's own website are filled in. Blank = not yet verified.

rows.name: Shanghai Museum (The Shanghai Museum on People's Square)
rows.days_open: Closed every Monday (except public holidays). Monday 15 Feb 2027 is a Monday, so this venue is closed on the first preferred trip day.
rows.booking: Walk-in for individual visitors since 1 Sep 2025. Reservations required in peak periods (including national holidays and school vacations); up to 14 days ahead via WeChat or the official website.

source.label: Shanghai Museum notice (25 Aug 2025) and official site footer

rows.name: Yu Garden (豫园), Shanghai
rows.days_open: Closed every Monday (except national holidays). Spring Festival hours follow the announcement at the time. Monday 15 Feb 2027 is a Monday, so it is closed on the first preferred trip day.
rows.ticket: Adult ¥30 in the off-season (1 Dec – 31 Mar). Adult ¥40 in peak months (1 Apr – 30 Jun and 1 Sep – 30 Nov). Half-price tickets for students aged 6–18 and visitors aged 60+ with valid ID.
rows.booking: Tickets at the north or south gate windows, or via the official '上海豫园' mini-program (WeChat).
